0022600034.text: The New York Knicks (6-4, on a four-game winning streak and 4th in the East) visit the Indiana Pacers (3-8, 12th in the East, on a two-game losing streak) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game. Indiana will be without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ben Sheppard (knee) and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with knee soreness and a game-time decision. The Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and beat the Pacers 136-110 in New York on March 17, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 season series.
